columns.title: Customize columns
columns.hint: Toggle columns on or off and use the arrows to reorder them. Your layout is saved to your account and follows you across devices.
columns.needOne: Keep at least one column visible.

columns.newOptionsPlaceholder: One per line, or comma separated

columns.deleteBody: Every value stored in {label}, for every user, will be permanently deleted along with the column. This cannot be undone.
columns.deleted: Column {label} deleted, along with {count} stored value(s).
columns.limitReached: You can have at most {max} custom columns.
columns.errDuplicate: A column with that name already exists.
columns.errBadLabel: That name has no usable characters. Use letters or numbers.
columns.errBadValue: That value does not match the column type.

issue.notAnOption: {label} must be one of its listed choices.

create.title: Add a new user

csv.title: Bulk import students
csv.dropHint: Drag and drop a CSV or Excel (.xlsx) file here, or click to browse.
csv.mapHint: Match each portal field to a column from your CSV file.

errors.forbidden: Only an administrator can import students.
errors.rateLimited: Too many imports. Please wait about {minutes} minute(s) and try again.
errors.missingFile: No file was received. Please choose a file and try again.
errors.badMapping: The column mapping couldn't be read. Reload the page and try again.
errors.tooLarge: That file is larger than the 5 MB limit. Split it into smaller files.
errors.unsupportedType: That doesn't look like a .csv or .xlsx file. Check the file and try again.
errors.legacyXls: Old-style .xls files aren't supported. Re-save it as .xlsx or .csv.
errors.tooManyRows: That file has more than 2,000 student rows. Split it into smaller files.
errors.tooManyColumns: That file has too many columns (limit 64).
errors.cellTooLong: One of the cells is longer than 500 characters. Shorten it and try again.
errors.noRows: No student rows were found in that file.
errors.noHeaders: No column headings were found. The first row must name the columns.
errors.corruptFile: That file couldn't be opened. Re-save it and try again.
errors.feesForbidden: You don't have permission to post fees. Remove the fee column mappings and try again.
errors.badFeeOptions: The fee options couldn't be read. Check the ledger date and note, then try again.

csv.feesHint: Optional. Map fee columns to post them to each student's fee ledger. Every non-zero amount becomes one ledger entry; blank or 0 cells are skipped.
csv.scholarshipOnTop: Tuition column shows only the student's share
csv.scholarshipOnTopHint: Adds the scholarship to the tuition charge, then credits it — so a student with Tuition 0 and Scholarship 45,455 is charged 45,455 and credited 45,455. Untick if the tuition column already holds the full fee.
csv.updateExisting: Also post fees to students who already exist
csv.updateExistingHint: Matches by roll number AND name. Entries already posted with the same date and amount are skipped, so re-uploading the same file won't double-charge.
